messages:
Lee H: Hi finance — corpcard declined for a late-night taxi in Tokyo, I paid out of pocket. Need to file reimbursement and check if there's any special handling for Japanese receipts.

Amount: JPY 3,200 (posted 2026-02-09)
Photo: https://files.redwood/receipts/taxi-2026-02-09.jpg
Started claim: `EXP-2026-0622`

Marta (Finance): Thanks Lee. For Japan we need the receipt showing merchant stamp and total in JPY. If it's in Japanese only that's fine. Upload the photo and your card statement. Mark currency as JPY.

Also note: Japan doesn't separate VAT like EU; local consumption tax is included in the total and reclaim rules vary. We'll reimburse full amount; tax reclaim, if any, is handled by our AP team centrally.

Lee H: Uploaded receipt + statement. The receipt is all Japanese characters and has a little stamp.

Tom (Manager): Approving — work taxi after midnight.

ExpenseBot: Expense `EXP-2026-0622` status changed to `Submitted` by Lee H.

Marta (Finance): Got the upload. I'll process reimbursement in JPY and convert to USD using our FX on the posted date. Expect payout in next 5 business days.

Lee H: Thanks! One extra Q — should I ever get the driver to write the company name on the receipt?

Marta (Finance): Not necessary for taxis. If it's a larger vendor or hotel we prefer company name but for taxis the receipt + statement is sufficient.

ExpenseBot: Expense `EXP-2026-0622` status changed to `Approved` by Tom. Reimbursement estimated in 3-5 business days.

Lee H: Appreciate it :bow:
